title: I Know Who You Are
synopsis: On the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China in 1949, Xiao Dali, who had just entered the city and was reorganized as the director of the public security police station, found that the primary school teacher Feng Jingbo was full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security soldier, he insisted on partnering with Feng and becoming his neighbor. He spent his whole life going through hardships and carried out a pursuit for nearly 40 years without regrets.

With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security soldier, he insisted on partnering with Feng and becoming his neighbor. He spent his whole life going through hardships and carried out a pursuit for nearly 40 years without regrets.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 億萬票房導演馮小剛年代力作，雷佳音、胡歌領銜主演！一場警察與特務的較量，卻展開滿是煙火與溫情的百姓人生。新中國成立之初，派出所所長肖大力（雷佳音 飾）憑直覺鎖定潛伏在土唐刀胡同15號院的特務「5182」馮靜波（胡歌 飾）。為追查真相，肖大力索性搬進院落，昔日追查者與目標成了朝夕相處的鄰居。兩人的交集，牽動著兩個家庭、兩代人的命運，歲月起落間滿是波折與變故。當閱盡半生風雨，這對相伴相鬥一輩子的冤家，早已不再是單純的宿敵。
